## The Science

Theta-state audio entrainment uses rhythmic sound pulses to gently guide your brain toward a calmer, more focused state. This method aligns with the brain’s natural tendency to shift into lower frequencies during relaxed awareness—often associated with creativity and mental reset.

Research on audio entrainment shows promise in supporting relaxation and cognitive clarity, though individual results vary. The Genius Song applies these principles in a concise, accessible format designed for everyday use. As with any audio-based support, consistent practice matters more than session length.
